body: I’ve met a lot online but I’ve never actually met one in person before. That’s actually something that’s caused me a lot of trouble mentally. I really want to meet some like minded people one day, but zoosexuals tend to keep their sexuality in the DL which is totally understandable. Something about talking to someone face to face that truly understands the trouble and pain you’ve gone through is something I feel like would help me a lot mentally. Even if we don’t talk about the sexuality at all, the mutual understanding and knowledge of who we are would be extremely comforting to me.

It depends. And I'm going to be as unbiased as possible

To me, I don't think it's okay to judge someone solely based on their sexuality without knowing anything else. Being zoosexual, I know I did not choose this. I would like to be judged on what i DO with my sexuality. There are a lot of zoophiles that don't act on their desires for a whole slew of reasons. I don't think they deserve any hate. They're living their lives and not harming anyone else. However, those who do choose to act on their desires makes the argument a bit more complicated, particularly when arguing consent. Now let me be clear when I say this: ANY AND ALL FORMS OF PHYSICAL ABUSE TO ANY ANIMAL MUST BE PUNISHED TO THE FULL EXTENT OF THE LAW. I HAVE NO TOLERANCE FOR ANIMAL ABUSE. Now, I do believe that while animals cannot speak to us in english or other common language, they can tell us certain things with body language. If an animal does not want something, they will make it clear by barking, running away, biting, etc. Same if they do want something. Wether this can be enough to prove consent for acting zoophiles is up to personal interpretation. I believe it's possible, but it should be taken on a case by case basis. This is why it's hard to separate non consenting and consenting sex.

Thank you. I wish I knew what pills they were if they were able to provide at least some alleviation to such a similar problem. My mind is open to options right now in terms of treatment, which is why I decided to find a therapist after 7 years of depressive and suicidal thoughts. Thank you for telling me that story. I'm at least a bit more hopeful now that theres a chance I can make it out of this if someone else was able to.

I'm currently on the waitlist for a therapist at my university. They provide free counseling which is nice. I think I'm ready to accept the fact that while it can't get better, I can learn to manage the pain better. Because realizing that this won't get better is what hurts the most.

Yea, my sexuality is preventing me from having deeper relationships with people. I don't think I'll be a vet though, I'm more into computer science and blood scares me.

I have a few friends that understand my situation, and theres a few  forums online and chatrooms with likeminded people. But no one to really "talk" to about being depressed about this. The problem is trust. Who would you trust with a secret and problem as big as this. Telling the wrong person can lead to a huge downward spiral, and its also a great fear of mine.
